### Borea v0.7.2

- The listing editor now recognizes mod ZIPs named after a full GitHub tag, such as `krpc-ksa-v1.2.3.zip`, when the listing uses a tag prefix. Thanks to @djungelorm for the proposal.

- Borea recognizes KSA build 2026.11.25.5949 as verified.

Full changelog: [v0.7.1...v0.7.2](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.7.1...v0.7.2)
